Assign an L1 regularization penalty factor (LLM-Lasso protocol) to each supplied baseline measurement using only the measurement descriptions and task description (no patient records or labels). Use an integer from 1 to 5: 1 = highly predictive (minimal penalty), 2 = moderately predictive, 3 = uncertain/weak, 4 = unlikely useful, 5 = irrelevant (maximum penalty). Return strict JSON with the single top-level key "penalties" mapping every supplied field ID to its integer penalty in {1,2,3,4,5}.
{"task": "Assess underlying chronic systemic illness and cardiometabolic perioperative risk at this thoracic procedure.", "fields": {"F3": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "preOp_age"}, "F7": {"description": "Assigned licorice or sugar-water gargle before anesthesia", "name": "treat"}, "F5": {"description": "Smoking status", "name": "preOp_smoking"}, "F8": {"description": "Extent and duration category of completed thoracic surgery", "name": "intraOp_surgerySize"}, "F1": {"description": "Preoperative ASA physical status", "name": "preOp_asa"}, "F4": {"description": "Mallampati airway examination score", "name": "preOp_mallampati"}, "F6": {"description": "Preoperative pain", "name": "preOp_pain"}, "F0": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "preOp_gender"}, "F2": {"description": "Body mass index", "name": "preOp_calcBMI"}}}
